syntactic_calques.regex: (我們|你們|他們|大家|我|你|請)(走|去|吃|食|看|試|試用|休息|離開|開始|登出|儲存)先(?=[，。！？；：、\s]|$)
syntactic_calques.rationale: Cantonese post-verbal adverb '先' ('走先') calqued into Standard Written Chinese; place '先' before the verb ('先走').

syntactic_calques.regex: (好|快|慢|貴|平|多|少|高|低|早|遲|大|小|強|弱)過(預期|以前|往年|舊版|上月|去年|標準|對手|其他)
syntactic_calques.rationale: Cantonese comparative 'Adj + 過 + NP' ('好過預期') calqued into Standard Written Chinese; use '比 + NP + Adj' ('比預期好') or '優於預期'.

syntactic_calques.regex: 給((?:一[份個封張本筆項條]|這[份個封張本筆項條])?[\u4e00-\u9fff]{1,4})(我|你|您|他|她|我們|你們|他們)(?=[，。！？；：、\s]|$)
syntactic_calques.rationale: Cantonese inverted double-object dative '畀 + DO + IO' calqued as '給一份報告我'; Standard Written Chinese requires '給我一份報告' or '寄一份報告給我'.

lshk_strict_rules.rationale: LSHK Jyutping 正字 prescribes '畀' (bei2) for Cantonese 'give / let' ('畀錢', '畀啲意見'); commercial UI mode (--standard ui / --cantonese-mode ui-yue) permits conventional '俾'.

In classical/modern orthography '哂' (san2) means 'smirk' ('不值一哂'); LSHK 正字 prescribes '晒' (saai3) for the Cantonese completive particle ('唔該晒', '食晒'), whereas commercial UI mode permits conventional '哂'.

lshk_strict_rules.wrong_regex: (試|睇|諗|等|問|聽|望|傾|玩|坐|唞)吓
lshk_strict_rules.rationale: LSHK 正字 uses '下' (haa5) for the post-verbal delimitative aspect ('諗下', '試下') and reserves '吓' (haa2) for the standalone interjection; commercial UI mode permits conventional '試吓'.
LSHK 正字 prescribes '而家' (now); '宜家' is accepted as a conventional variant in commercial UI mode (and preserved for IKEA '宜家家居').
LSHK 正字 prescribes '而家' (now) rather than phonetic '依家'.
LSHK distinguishes demonstrative '噉' (gam2, '噉樣' = like this) from degree adverb '咁' (gam3, '咁好' = so good); commercial UI mode allows merged '咁樣'.
